instructions: Play sixteen bars of drums in 4/4. Listen to the other players. Keep a steady snare on two and four. Choose a four-bar groove at a time and save the toms for the turnaround.

steady.means: Kick on one and three, snare on two and four, quarter-note hats.

space.means: Leave beat three to the hat in alternate bars.

pickup.means: Push the kick onto the offbeat in the second and fourth bars.

hats.means: Open up the rhythm with eighth-note closed hats in bars two and four.

short_fill.means: Keep the backbeat and answer the last snare with two low tom hits.

rolling_fill.means: Move from hats to a descending three-tom fill in the last two beats.

slots.case: Bars 5–8. Decide how active the hi-hat should be.
Bars 9–12. Set up the last four bars.
